# Paths the adapter refuses by their spelling (checkPath), wherever a caller
# hands one: a Blob of a rev and a Commit of the work tree both refuse each
# before git runs. A line is a path as a Go string literal, then what it is.
# Some are spelled as one system's paths, so they are data here, not code.
"" an empty path
"/work/scratch/x" an absolute path
"../x" a path that climbs
"a/../b" a path through ..
"sub/../rules.yaml" a path through .. to a file the tree holds
"a//b" an empty name
"./a" a name that is .
"a/" a path that ends in a slash
".git/config" the .git folder
".GIT/config" a .GIT folder
"a/.GIT/x" a .GIT folder below the top
"a\\b" a backslash
"sub\\d.txt" a backslash between names the tree holds
"a\x01b" a control character
"a\nb" a newline
"\xff" a byte that is not UTF-8
